name: Raiden suspected Mileena's talisman was Shinnok's amulet
notes: After Li Mei describes the talisman, Raiden warns that if it is what he suspects everyone may be at risk. Kung Jin asks whether they are talking about Shinnok's amulet; Sonya objects that the amulet should be secured, and Raiden says he must be certain. The structured claim therefore remains suspicion/identification-in-progress rather than a completed possession confirmation.
